title: Tropical Casio Stab Cloud
description: A casio keyboard sample mangled beyond recognition — chopped into 16 grains, striated, speed-stepped through forward/reverse/half-time/double-time, and filtered into a plucky tropical stab cloud that the original sample never contained. Three mutually-prime LFO clocks (7, 13, 16 cycles) drive filter drift, stereo pan, and speed steps so the granular cloud breathes and shifts continuously across the 16-cycle morph arc.
